title: Trip budget deflated fuel cost to top-up liters instead of full trip fuel consumed
root_cause: fuelCost in budgetService was conditionally set to additionalFuelRequired instead of fuelRequired.
reproduction_steps: Plan a 505.5 km round trip with vehicle efficiency 15 km/l and 30L initial tank. Fuel expense previously showed ₹381 instead of ₹3,466.

title: Round-trip distance calculation missing top-level totalDistanceKm in trip/plan API
root_cause: API returned distanceKm inside route object only, causing clients checking root attributes to miss distance value.
reproduction_steps: POST /api/trip/plan with start and end both set to origin and destination as waypoint. Root totalDistanceKm was missing.
